tools.name: llm_cost_estimate

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: about_alexey_shurov, open_plan_page · Private data: llm_price_lookup, llm_cost_estimate, search_shurco, about_alexey_shurov, open_plan_page, read_plan_page · Public sink: automation_roi, score_automation_candidate, about_alexey_shurov, open_plan_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: about_alexey_shurov, open_plan_page · Private data: llm_price_lookup, llm_cost_estimate, search_shurco, about_alexey_shurov, open_plan_page, read_plan_page · Public sink: automation_roi, score_automation_candidate, about_alexey_shurov, open_plan_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "score_automation_candidate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
